title: Blitzkrieg removal
summary: The Panda FF2 removal proposal for The Blitzkrieg was marked completed, removing the boss from the active roster.

title: Hatsune Miku re-added
summary: The Hatsune Miku re-suggestion was marked completed. The published design uses Scout movement, a Saxxy, Super Jump and a DCP-based ability system.

title: Cirno removal
summary: The dedicated Cirno removal vote was marked completed in the Panda FF2 archive.

title: Foxy removed
summary: The proposal to remove Foxy was marked completed. The thread described the boss as underplayed, underpowered and in need of a larger rework.

title: Saxton Hale reworked
summary: Saxton Hale received a VScript VSH-inspired rework. The published rework replaces the old ability set and includes Brave Jump and Mighty Slam.

title: Spells removed
summary: The FF2 proposal to remove the recently enabled spell system was marked completed.

title: Recent Vaccinator changes removed
summary: The forum request to remove the recent Vaccinator rework was marked completed on October 2, 2025. Keep the sticky current-weapon thread as the authority for the exact live setup.

title: Easter Bunny re-added
summary: The proposal to bring Easter Bunny back to the FF2 boss roster was marked completed.

title: Blightcaller rework
summary: A rework that brought back the older Blightcaller concept with revised abilities was marked completed.

title: Current FF2 Weapon Changes thread
summary: Panda's sticky Current FF2 Weapon Changes thread is the canonical reference for live weapon modifications. This site should mirror that thread instead of treating old suggestions as current balance.

title: Freak Fortress 2: Rewrite
summary: Panda approved moving to FF2 Rewrite, bringing improved stability, a reworked boss-selection system, updated duo handling, a new HUD and integrated custom weapon-attribute support.
